testcase.name: Scenario: Select templates with the secondary mouse button: tmp/obk-bdd-template-m1iAUYjQ/checkout/features/application/document-creation/document-creation.feature:523:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select templates with the secondary mouse button ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the English folder grouped by type using Medium icons ✔ And the Part group contains Standard (in) and Sheet Metal (in) ✔ When the user right-clicks the Standard (in) part template ✔ Then Standard (in) is selected and its details show inch units ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user right-clicks the Sheet Metal (in) part template ✔ Then Sheet Metal (in) is selected and its details show inch units ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user right-clicks empty space in the Part gallery ✔ Then Sheet Metal (in) remains selected and its details remain displayed ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the chooser closes and the original part remains active
